title: Semiconductor unit volumes and average selling prices by product class (WSTS units, 2015-2026)
why_it_matters: 2025-2026 growth is price-driven (memory ASPs, AI chips at <0.2% of units) while foundational chip volumes rise and prices fall; no public unit series after 2021 was found.
questions: What were total and per-category WSTS unit shipments and ASPs for 2015-2025?
How many units do AI accelerators, MCUs, discretes and analog represent, and at what ASPs?
Can JEITA/WSTS Japan or company data recover unit series that SIA stopped publishing after 2021?
